diagnosis.cause: After MSVC environment setup, the step environment retains the name Platform with value windows. Bash variable names are case-sensitive, so the uppercase PLATFORM branch does not select the Windows DLL.
diagnosis.smallest_proposed_fix: Use TARGET_PLATFORM instead of PLATFORM for workflow input environment variables and shell comparisons.
diagnosis.local_shell_reproduction: env -u PLATFORM Platform=windows bash reproduces selected=linux, retained_Platform=windows, uppercase_PLATFORM=unset.
